summary: Iteration 11 testing complete - Bank accounts management, Bank transfer top-up flow, Wave A Pre-flight validation, Wave B Saved CSV mappings. Backend: 43/43 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All new features verified working.

issues: Minor console warning about <span> inside <option> - React hydration warning, non-blocking

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/banks returns seeded CRDB Bank row (super_admin required)
POST /api/admin/banks creates bank with country uppercased; PUT/DELETE work correctly
GET /api/banks (client auth) returns banks scoped to user.country OR country='*'
POST /api/wallet/topups creates pending topup_request with local currency amount + credits_on_approval; proof_image excluded from response
GET /api/wallet/topups returns client's topup history without proof_image
GET /api/wallet/topups/{tid}/proof returns proof image for owning client
GET /api/admin/approvals/inbox includes 'topup_requests' in payload and 'total' counts them
GET /api/admin/topups/{tid} (admin) MUST include proof_image - verified working
POST /api/admin/topups/{tid}/review with status='approved' adds credits_on_approval to wallet, records tx_kind='topup_bank'
POST /api/admin/topups/{tid}/review with status='rejected' does NOT credit wallet - verified
Already-reviewed topups return 400 - verified
POST /api/messaging/preflight is FREE (no credit deduction) - verified wallet unchanged
Preflight samples up to 20 numbers, returns checked/total_in_list/valid_pct/buckets/predicted_valid/predicted_failed/countries/operators/warning/results
Warning is set when valid_pct < 80, null otherwise - verified
Empty phones returns 400 - verified
POST /api/messaging/csv-mappings creates mapping; same name upserts
GET /api/messaging/csv-mappings returns only current user's maps
POST /api/messaging/csv-mappings/{id}/used sets last_used_at
DELETE /api/messaging/csv-mappings/{id} removes mapping; 404 for other user's map
Admin Banks page at /admin/banks renders with seeded CRDB Bank row, supports Add/Edit/Delete via modal
Settings Hub → Distribution & treasury group shows Bank accounts module link
Client Wallet shows packs in LOCAL currency (TZS for TZ client) with 'LOCAL VALUE' badge
Client Wallet has 'Pay by bank transfer' button per pack, opens BankPayModal with bank details, file upload, reference field
Admin Approvals has 'Top-up requests' tab with count badge
Client Bulk Send has Pre-flight check block with 'Validate sample before sending' button
Preflight result shows Checked, Deliverable %, Predicted wasted credits, warning/success message
Client Bulk Send has Saved column maps card with Apply/Delete buttons
